errors.no_baseline: Finish Part 3 first. Your Iteration 0 files and results are the starting point for every attempt.
errors.no_start_files: {files} was not found in your project folder, so there is nothing to copy for attempt {n}. Finish Part 3 first.
errors.undecided: Attempt {n} is still waiting for your decision. Choose keep or undo for it before you start another.
errors.hypothesis_needed: Write and save your hypothesis for attempt {n} first. It says what you expect your change to do, and it has to exist before you run anything.
errors.hypothesis_blank: Write your hypothesis before you save it.
errors.hypothesis_locked: Attempt {n} has already been run, so its hypothesis cannot change now. A hypothesis written after the result is not a prediction.
errors.hypothesis_changed: The hypothesis saved for attempt {n} was changed outside the app. Save it again in the hypothesis step.
errors.bad_text: That text could not be saved.
errors.answers_missing: Attempt {n} needs five saved answers before it can be scored. Missing or empty: {files}.
errors.file_missing: {name} was not found in the folder for attempt {n}.
errors.changed_while_running: A file for attempt {n} changed while the checker was running, so the result was not saved. Run it again.
errors.already_decided: Attempt {n} is already marked {decision}, so it cannot be scored again.
errors.not_scored: Score attempt {n} before you decide about it.
errors.stale: The {what} for attempt {n} changed after it was scored. Score it again before you decide.
errors.rerun_needed: Your corrected checker gives different results on your original five answers. Run those five again with it and record a corrected Iteration 0 before comparing any attempt.
errors.known_good_needed: Save your known-good answer first. Its score is shown only after you have chosen it.
errors.known_good_blank: Write your known-good answer before you save it.
errors.no_run_test: promptfooconfig.yaml has no test named run-1 to copy the checks from.
errors.folder_busy: The files for attempt {n} could not be saved: {error}
errors.busy: A checker is still running. Wait for it to finish.

evidence.no_gain: no measured gain on these rules
evidence.coverage_not_gain: The set of rules changed, so this is not counted as a gain.
evidence.line: Attempt {n}: {verdict}. The score went from {before} to {after}.

coverage.changed: The set of rules is different from Iteration 0 ({details}). This is not counted as a gain.
coverage.lost: {ids} became NOT CHECKED, so that coverage is lost

known_good.meets: Your known-good answer passes {passes} of {checked} checked results, which meets the 95% mark.
known_good.below: Your known-good answer passes {passes} of {checked} checked results, which is under the 95% mark.
known_good.none_checked: No result was checked for your known-good answer, so it cannot meet the 95% mark.
known_good.next_step: Check the checker or the written requirements: open the rule that failed and decide whether the checker or the requirement is wrong. Do not loosen a rule to make the answer pass.

five_answers.met: Your five answers pass {passes} of {total} checked results, which meets the 95% target.
five_answers.below: Your five answers pass {passes} of {total} checked results. The target is 95%. It is a goal and not a gate.
five_answers.next_step: Pick the rule that fails most often, write one hypothesis about it and change one thing.

completion.done: You have documented {count} rounds after Iteration 0.
completion.need_one: You have documented {count} of 2 rounds after Iteration 0. One more round is needed.
completion.need_two: You have documented {count} of 2 rounds after Iteration 0. Two more rounds are needed.

decision.label: Attempt {n} decision matches
decision.ok: The log and the app agree on the decision.

hypothesis.label: Attempt {n} hypothesis is the saved one
hypothesis.ok: The log's Hypothesis is the text you saved, ignoring spacing.

scored.label: Attempt {n} was scored on the files it has now

counts.label: Attempt {n} pass counts match the app's count
counts.ok: Every pass count and the overall total match.

not_checked.label: Attempt {n} NOT CHECKED criteria are listed
not_checked.ok: The log lists the same criteria as not checked.

problems.no_log: iteration-log.md was not found in your project folder.
problems.no_entry: The log has no entry for attempt {n}. It should start with a heading such as Iteration {n}: your change.
problems.two_entries: The log has more than one entry for attempt {n}. Keep one in iteration-log.md.
problems.decision_missing: The log entry for attempt {n} has no Decision line. It should say kept, undone or pending.
problems.decision_differs: The log says attempt {n} was {log}. The app has it as {app}.
problems.hypothesis_unsaved: No hypothesis is saved for attempt {n}, so the log cannot be compared with it.
problems.hypothesis_missing: The log entry for attempt {n} has no Hypothesis. The saved one says: {saved}
problems.hypothesis_differs: The Hypothesis in the log for attempt {n} is not the one you saved. Saved: {saved} Log: {log}
problems.not_scored: Attempt {n} has not been scored yet.
problems.stale: The {what} for attempt {n} changed after it was scored. Score it again.
problems.results_missing: The saved results for attempt {n} could not be read. Score it again.
problems.results_changed: The saved results for attempt {n} do not match the app's record. Score it again.
problems.wait_scored: This is compared once attempt {n} has been scored.

nudge_coverage.text: Attempt {n} reports a different set of rules from Iteration 0. It is flagged and is never counted as a gain.
